(
                $"SELECT * FROM Inv WHERE IS_Deleted=0 AND inv_type=6 " +
                $"AND proc_type={procType} AND InvGlobalID=N'{globalId}'")

(
                $"SELECT * FROM Inv WHERE IS_Deleted=0 AND inv_type=7 " +
                $"AND proc_type={procType} AND InvGlobalID=N'{globalId}'")

($"SELECT * FROM Inv WHERE IS_Deleted=0 " +
                                   $"AND proc_type=1 AND inv_type=6 AND id={invNo}")

($"SELECT * FROM Inv WHERE IS_Deleted=0 " +
                                   $"AND proc_type=2 AND inv_type=6 AND id={invNo}")

(
                $"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM Inv " +
                $"WHERE inv_type={InvType} AND proc_type={ProcType} " +
                $"AND IS_Deleted=0 ORDER BY id ASC")

(
                $"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM Inv " +
                $"WHERE inv_type={InvType} AND proc_type={ProcType} " +
                $"AND IS_Deleted=0 AND id<{_code} ORDER BY id DESC")

(
                $"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM Inv " +
                $"WHERE inv_type={InvType} AND proc_type={ProcType} " +
                $"AND IS_Deleted=0 AND id>{_code} ORDER BY id ASC")

(
                $"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM Inv " +
                $"WHERE inv_type={InvType} AND proc_type={ProcType} " +
                $"AND IS_Deleted=0 ORDER BY id DESC")
